阿瑞斯基地: 有人在{what}旁弹吉他。弹得很烂。但很可爱。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I stayed out by the {what} past curfew.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}在{what}旁待过了门禁时间。

Ares Habitat: Fireflies all round the {what}. Like the whole street was glowing.
阿瑞斯基地: {what}周围全是萤火虫。好像整条街都在发光。

Ares Habitat: From your {what}. Mom made a pie with it.
阿瑞斯基地: 来自你的{what}。妈妈用它做了个派。

Ares Habitat: Your {what} came up great. Here, take some.
阿瑞斯基地: 你的{what}长得真好。给，拿点去。

Ares Habitat: Picked this from your {what}. The diner wants to buy some.
阿瑞斯基地: 从你的{what}上摘的。餐馆想买一些。

Ares Habitat: First of the season, from your {what}.
阿瑞斯基地: 这一季的头一批，来自你的{what}。

Ares Habitat: Your {what} beats anything at the supermarket.
阿瑞斯基地: 你的{what}比超市里的任何东西都好。

Ares Habitat: Sat on the {what} and watched the waves.
The {what} is out of the wind. Bliss.
Napped by the {what} with my beak under my wing.
阿瑞斯基地: 把嘴塞在翅膀底下，在{what}旁打了个盹。

Ares Habitat: The chicks climb the {what}. I sat on it anyway.
阿瑞斯基地: 小企鹅们爬上了{what}。我还是在上面坐了会儿。

Ares Habitat: Watched the fishers come home from the {what}.
Five minutes on the {what}. Then back to the ice.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{what}上歇五分钟。然后回到冰上去。

Ares Habitat: The {what} is the best spot on the floe. Don't tell anyone.
阿瑞斯基地: {what}是浮冰上最好的位置。别告诉别人。

Ares Habitat: Preened my feathers on the {what}. Very smart now.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{what}上梳理了羽毛。现在很精神。

Ares Habitat: Whoever made the {what} has a good heart.
We huddled by the {what} and sang the old songs.
{other} and I shared a herring by the {what}.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}在{what}旁分了一条鲱鱼。

Ares Habitat: Half the colony was by the {what} under the aurora.
阿瑞斯基地: 极光下半个聚居地的人都在{what}旁边。

Ares Habitat: {other} told a fish story by the {what}. It grew.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}在{what}旁讲了个鱼的故事。越讲越大。

Ares Habitat: By the {what} the long night feels shorter.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{what}旁边，长夜好像短了些。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I counted stars by the {what}.
The chicks fell asleep round the {what}. So did I.
阿瑞斯基地: 小企鹅们围着{what}睡着了。我也是。

Ares Habitat: {other} taught me a new song by the {what}.
Stayed by the {what} till the fishers came in.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{what}旁一直待到渔民回来。

Ares Habitat: The {what} glows on the ice. You can see it from the far floe.
阿瑞斯基地: {what}在冰上发着光。从远处的浮冰上都能看见。

Ares Habitat: From your {what}. Fresh as the sea.
阿瑞斯基地: 来自你的{what}。和大海一样新鲜。

Ares Habitat: Your {what} did well in the cold. This is yours.
阿瑞斯基地: 你的{what}在寒冷中长得很好。这是你的。

Ares Habitat: Picked this from your {what}. The chicks wanted it.
阿瑞斯基地: 从你的{what}上采的。小企鹅们也想要。

Ares Habitat: First of the thaw, from your {what}.
阿瑞斯基地: 解冻后的第一批，来自你的{what}。

Ares Habitat: Your {what} keeps giving. The vault's jealous.
阿瑞斯基地: 你的{what}一直有收获。鱼库都嫉妒了。

Ares Habitat: Sat on the {what} and counted the dust devils. Six.
The {what} creaks in the cold. So do I.
Had my ration bar on the {what}. Five-star dining.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{what}上吃了口粮棒。五星级用餐。

Ares Habitat: Wrote a letter home sitting on the {what}.
阿瑞斯基地: 坐在{what}上给家里写了封信。

Ares Habitat: The {what} is where I go when the alarms stop.
阿瑞斯基地: 警报停了以后，我就去{what}那儿。

Ares Habitat: Sat on the {what} with my eyes shut. Pretended it was a beach.
阿瑞斯基地: 闭着眼睛坐在{what}上。假装是在海滩。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I argued about Earth music by the {what}. Nobody won.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}在{what}旁争论地球音乐。谁也没赢。

Ares Habitat: Someone brought cards to the {what}. We played till the lights dimmed.
阿瑞斯基地: 有人把纸牌带到了{what}旁。我们一直玩到灯光调暗。

Ares Habitat: {other} fell asleep by the {what}. We left them a blanket.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}在{what}旁睡着了。我们给他们盖了条毯子。

Ares Habitat: The {what} has become the place to be after a dust storm.
阿瑞斯基地: 沙尘暴过后，{what}成了大家必去的地方。

Ares Habitat: {other} showed me the stars from beside the {what}.
We had a quiz by the {what}. Nia won. Nia always wins.
阿瑞斯基地: 我们在{what}旁搞了个问答比赛。妮娅赢了。妮娅总是赢。

Ares Habitat: Did my homework on the {what}. Some of it.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{what}上写了作业。写了一部分。

Ares Habitat: Fell asleep on the {what} in the sun. Woke up pink.
阿瑞斯基地: 在太阳下的{what}上睡着了。醒来晒红了。

Ares Habitat: Watched the paper boy miss every porch from the {what}.
阿瑞斯基地: 坐在{what}上看送报的男孩没扔中一个门廊。

Ares Habitat: Sat on the {what} and waited for nothing in particular.
The {what} is my thinking spot now. Don't tell.
阿瑞斯基地: {what}现在是我思考的地方。别说出去。

Ares Habitat: Read the Sunday paper on the {what}. All of it.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{what}上看完了周日的报纸。整份。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I watched the fireflies by the {what}.
Somebody's radio by the {what} played K-88 all night.
阿瑞斯基地: {what}旁有人的收音机放了一整夜K-88。

Ares Habitat: {other} taught me a card trick by the {what}.
The {what} is where you hear all the gossip now.
阿瑞斯基地: 现在在{what}旁能听到所有的八卦。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I sat by the {what} and talked about leaving. Then didn't.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}坐在{what}旁聊着离开。然后都没走。

Ares Habitat: We roasted marshmallows by the {what}. Mostly burned them.
阿瑞斯基地: 我们在{what}旁烤棉花糖。大部分都烤焦了。

Ares Habitat: Stood on one foot by the {what}. Very restful.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{what}旁单脚站着。非常放松。

Ares Habitat: The {what} is warm on the sunny side.
Watched the seals from the {what}. They watched back.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{what}上看海豹。它们也看着我。

Ares Habitat: Had a long think on the {what}. About fish, mostly.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{what}上想了很久。主要是关于鱼。

Ares Habitat: Sat on the {what} and let the snow cover me. Cosy.
阿瑞斯基地: 坐在{what}上任雪盖住我。很舒服。

Ares Habitat: The {what} is where I go to be quiet.
阿瑞斯基地: 想安静的时候我就去{what}那儿。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I told jokes by the {what}. Mine were better.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}在{what}旁讲笑话。我的更好笑。

Ares Habitat: Everyone brought a fish to the {what}. We had a feast.
阿瑞斯基地: 每个人都带了条鱼到{what}旁。我们吃了一顿大餐。

Ares Habitat: {other} danced by the {what}. The chicks copied.
The {what} is the colony's favourite spot now.
阿瑞斯基地: {what}现在是聚居地最受欢迎的地方。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I watched the ice glow by the {what}.
We played pebble games by the {what} till the tide turned.
阿瑞斯基地: 我们在{what}旁玩鹅卵石游戏，一直玩到潮水转向。

Ares Habitat: watch the shuttle launch from the ridge
drive the rover out to the dunes
eat supper in the airlock with the door open to the stars
阿瑞斯基地: 在舱门朝着星空敞开的气闸里吃晚饭

Ares Habitat: {other} and I pulled a kilo of dust out of one filter.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}从一个滤网里掏出了一公斤灰。

Ares Habitat: Filter duty with {other}. We both sneezed for an hour.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}清洗滤网。我们俩打了一个小时喷嚏。

Ares Habitat: {other} swears the filters breed dust at night.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}发誓滤网晚上会自己生出灰来。

Ares Habitat: Clean filters, clean air. {other} took the credit.
阿瑞斯基地: 滤网干净了，空气也干净了。功劳{other}领走了。

Ares Habitat: Changed every filter at {place} with {other}. Breathing's easier.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}把{place}的滤网全换了。喘气都顺了。

Ares Habitat: {name} read the letters the shuttle brought
Read my mother's letter four times. She sent a pressed leaf.
阿瑞斯基地: 把我妈的信读了四遍。她寄来了一片压干的叶子。

Ares Habitat: A letter from Earth. It smells like paper. Real paper.
阿瑞斯基地: 一封地球来的信。有纸的味道。真正的纸。

Ares Habitat: My sister had a baby. I found out from a letter two months late.
阿瑞斯基地: 我姐姐生了孩子。我从一封晚了两个月的信里才知道。

Ares Habitat: {friend} read me the funny bits of their letters too.
阿瑞斯基地: {friend}也把他们信里好笑的段落读给我听。

Ares Habitat: Wrote back six pages. The shuttle's gone. It'll wait.
阿瑞斯基地: 回了六页信。飞船已经走了。信可以等。

Ares Habitat: {name} played cards in the new dome with {other}
{other} and I played cards till the lights dimmed for night.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}打牌打到夜间调暗灯光。
{other}打牌作弊。光明正大。还很得意。

Ares Habitat: Poker for ration bars with {other}. I'm rich in oat bars.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}用口粮棒当赌注打扑克。我的燕麦棒多得是。

Ares Habitat: The new dome echoes. {other} sang between hands.
阿瑞斯基地: 新穹顶里有回声。{other}在两局之间唱歌。

Ares Habitat: Taught {other} a card game from home. They beat me at it.
阿瑞斯基地: 教{other}玩一个家乡的纸牌游戏。结果他们赢了我。

Ares Habitat: {name} trained the new crew on the rover with {other}
{other} drove the rover into a ditch. Gently.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}把漫游车开进了沟里。轻轻地。

Ares Habitat: Taught {other} to read the dust. Left means trouble.
阿瑞斯基地: 教{other}看沙尘。往左飘就有麻烦。

Ares Habitat: Rover training with {other}. We only got lost twice.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}练开漫游车。我们只迷路了两次。

Ares Habitat: {other} parked the rover perfectly. First try. Show-off.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}一次就把漫游车停得完美无缺。爱显摆。

Ares Habitat: Showed {other} the old tracks to the crater. They're still there.
阿瑞斯基地: 带{other}看了通往陨石坑的旧车辙。现在还在。

Ares Habitat: At night you can see both moons at once from here.
阿瑞斯基地: 晚上在这里能同时看到两个卫星。

Ares Habitat: Every new crop starts here. I talk to them. It helps.
阿瑞斯基地: 每种新作物都从这里开始。我会跟它们说话。有用的。

Ares Habitat: Every trip since the first. Some of the entries are poems.
阿瑞斯基地: 从第一次出车起的每趟行程都在上面。有些记录是诗。

Ares Habitat: Every window I think about going home. Then I don't.
阿瑞斯基地: 每个窗口期我都想回家。然后我又没走。

Ares Habitat: The pilot waves every time. I wave back. Every time.
阿瑞斯基地: 飞行员每次都挥手。我每次都挥手回应。

Ares Habitat: I miss rain most. Not the sea. Rain.
阿瑞斯基地: 我最想念的是雨。不是大海。是雨。

Ares Habitat: From here Earth's just a bright star. Hard to believe.
阿瑞斯基地: 从这里看，地球只是一颗亮星。真难相信。

Ares Habitat: It's bigger than it needs to be. On purpose.
阿瑞斯基地: 它比需要的大。是故意的。

Ares Habitat: We argued for weeks about the colour. It's grey.
阿瑞斯基地: 我们为了颜色吵了好几个星期。结果是灰色。

Ares Habitat: watch the storm roll in from the observation blister
walk the dunes after the storm
dig out the old lander together
阿瑞斯基地: 一起把旧着陆器挖出来

Ares Habitat: {other} and I taped every seam at {place}. Twice.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}把{place}的每道接缝都贴了胶带。贴了两遍。

Ares Habitat: Sandbags on the windward side with {other}. My back says no.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}在迎风面堆沙袋。我的腰说不行了。

Ares Habitat: {other} checked the seals while I held the torch.
Storm shutters down. {other} says we're ready. We're not.
阿瑞斯基地: 风暴挡板放下了。{other}说我们准备好了。其实没有。

Ares Habitat: Tied down everything that could fly with {other}.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}把所有可能被吹飞的东西都绑牢了。

Ares Habitat: {name} slept through the worst of the storm
The storm howled all night. I slept like a stone.
阿瑞斯基地: 风暴嚎了一整夜。我睡得像块石头。

Ares Habitat: Woke up and the window was brown. Went back to sleep.
阿瑞斯基地: 醒来窗户是褐色的。又睡了回去。

Ares Habitat: The walls hummed with the wind. Better than music.
阿瑞斯基地: 墙壁随着风嗡嗡作响。比音乐还好听。

Ares Habitat: {friend} made me tea at three in the morning. The storm was loud.
阿瑞斯基地: 凌晨三点{friend}给我泡了茶。风暴太吵了。

Ares Habitat: Dreamed of calm skies. Woke to dust. Still nice.
阿瑞斯基地: 梦见了晴朗的天空。醒来满眼是灰。还是很好。

Ares Habitat: {name} told stories with {other} while the storm blew
{other} told a ghost story. The storm did the sound effects.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}讲了个鬼故事。风暴负责音效。

Ares Habitat: Stuck inside with {other} for six sols. We're still friends.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}困在屋里六个火星日。我们还是朋友。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I played every board game we own. Twice.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}把我们所有的棋盘游戏都玩了。两遍。

Ares Habitat: Candles in the mess while the power saved. {other} sang.
阿瑞斯基地: 省电的时候食堂里点着蜡烛。{other}唱了歌。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I counted the gusts. Lost count at nine hundred.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}数着阵风。数到九百就乱了。

Ares Habitat: Storm watch with {other}. We read the wind gauge every hour.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}值风暴班。每小时读一次风速计。

Ares Habitat: {other} spotted the storm's edge before the instruments did.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}比仪器还早发现了风暴的边缘。

Ares Habitat: Kept the log through the night with {other}. All green.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}记了一整晚的日志。一切正常。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I watched the storm light up with static. Beautiful.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}看着风暴里闪着静电的光。真美。

Ares Habitat: The storm's passing. {other} and I shook hands on it.
阿瑞斯基地: 风暴正在过去。我和{other}为此握了握手。

Ares Habitat: Six bunks, a lamp and a crate of biscuits. Enough.
阿瑞斯基地: 六张铺位、一盏灯，还有一箱饼干。够了。

Ares Habitat: the wind gauge on the greenhouse roof
It spun so fast in the storm it sang.
阿瑞斯基地: 风暴里它转得太快，都唱起歌来了。

Ares Habitat: Patched eleven times. Each patch has a name.
阿瑞斯基地: 补了十一次。每块补丁都有名字。

Ares Habitat: Forty sols of brown sky. I thought I'd forget the sun.
阿瑞斯基地: 四十个火星日的褐色天空。我以为我会忘了太阳长什么样。

Ares Habitat: We lost the old antenna. Found it a kilometre away.
阿瑞斯基地: 我们丢了旧天线。在一公里外找到的。

Ares Habitat: In a dust storm your hair stands up. Everyone's hair.
阿瑞斯基地: 沙尘暴里你的头发会竖起来。所有人的头发。

Ares Habitat: I got a shock off the door handle. The whole storm long.
阿瑞斯基地: 整场风暴期间我摸门把手都会被电。

Ares Habitat: When it came back after the storm, we all went outside. In suits.
阿瑞斯基地: 风暴过后太阳重新出来，我们全都跑出去了。穿着宇航服。

Ares Habitat: The sun's smaller here. You love it more.
阿瑞斯基地: 这里的太阳小一些。你会更爱它。

Ares Habitat: ride along on the trade run to Tharsis
listen to the Tharsis radio show together
阿瑞斯基地: 一起听塔尔西斯的电台节目

Ares Habitat: climb the ridge to wave at the Tharsis convoy
阿瑞斯基地: 爬上山脊向塔尔西斯车队挥手

Ares Habitat: Loaded forty sacks of wheat with {other}. Tharsis sends pipes back.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}装了四十袋小麦。塔尔西斯回送管子。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I packed the trade crates. Labelled in two languages.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}打包了贸易箱。用两种语言贴了标签。

Ares Habitat: {other} haggled with Tharsis over the radio. We won. I think.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}通过无线电跟塔尔西斯讨价还价。我们赢了。大概吧。

Ares Habitat: The trade rover's heavy. {other} sat on the crates to close them.
阿瑞斯基地: 贸易车装得很重。{other}坐在箱子上才把它们合上。

Ares Habitat: Counted the Tharsis goods with {other}. Someone sent us cheese.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}清点塔尔西斯送来的货。有人给我们寄了奶酪。

Ares Habitat: Tharsis radio plays old songs. I know all the words.
阿瑞斯基地: 塔尔西斯电台放老歌。每句歌词我都会。

Ares Habitat: Fell asleep to the Tharsis weather report. Soothing.
阿瑞斯基地: 听着塔尔西斯的天气预报睡着了。很安神。

Ares Habitat: The Tharsis DJ said hello to Ares. I cheered alone.
阿瑞斯基地: 塔尔西斯的DJ向阿瑞斯问好。我一个人欢呼。

Ares Habitat: {friend} and I have a favourite Tharsis show now.
阿瑞斯基地: {friend}和我现在有了一个最喜欢的塔尔西斯节目。

Ares Habitat: Static, then music. Someone else is out here. Nice.
阿瑞斯基地: 先是杂音，然后是音乐。这里还有别人。真好。

Ares Habitat: The Tharsis traders brought a song. {other} learned it by supper.
阿瑞斯基地: 塔尔西斯商人带来了一首歌。{other}到晚饭时就学会了。

Ares Habitat: {other} gave the traders a tour. They loved the greenhouse.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}带商人们参观了一圈。他们爱死了温室。

Ares Habitat: Supper for fourteen with {other}. We ran out of chairs.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}张罗了十四个人的晚饭。椅子都不够了。

Ares Habitat: {other} traded jokes with the Tharsis crew. Theirs are worse.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}和塔尔西斯的人互讲笑话。他们的更冷。

Ares Habitat: The traders stayed an extra sol. {other} didn't mind at all.
阿瑞斯基地: 商人们多待了一个火星日。{other}一点也不介意。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I marked every rock on the way to Tharsis.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}把去塔尔西斯路上的每块石头都标了出来。

Ares Habitat: Mapped the canyon shortcut with {other}. Saves a whole sol.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}绘出了峡谷捷径。能省一整个火星日。

Ares Habitat: {other} named a crater after me. It's a small crater.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}用我的名字给一个陨石坑命名。是个小坑。

Ares Habitat: The trade map's done. {other} framed it.
阿瑞斯基地: 贸易路线图完成了。{other}把它裱了起来。

Ares Habitat: {other} says the route's safe. I believe it.
We talk to Tharsis every evening at seven. Sometimes they talk back.
阿瑞斯基地: 我们每晚七点跟塔尔西斯通话。有时他们会回话。

Ares Habitat: Tharsis cheese, Tharsis socks, one Tharsis poem.
阿瑞斯基地: 塔尔西斯的奶酪、塔尔西斯的袜子，还有一首塔尔西斯的诗。

Ares Habitat: We fly it so Tharsis knows we're friendly.
阿瑞斯基地: 我们挂着它，让塔尔西斯知道我们是友好的。

Ares Habitat: They've got forty people and a piano. A piano!
阿瑞斯基地: 他们有四十个人和一架钢琴。钢琴！

Ares Habitat: Their mayor calls us the neighbours. I like that.
阿瑞斯基地: 他们的镇长管我们叫邻居。我喜欢这个说法。

Ares Habitat: Wheat for pipes, songs for cheese. Fair's fair.
阿瑞斯基地: 小麦换管子，歌换奶酪。公平交易。

Ares Habitat: I've never bargained before. I'm very bad at it.
阿瑞斯基地: 我以前从没讨价还价过。我很不擅长。

Ares Habitat: A voice from over the horizon. It still gives me chills.
阿瑞斯基地: 地平线那边传来的声音。现在还会让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

Ares Habitat: I know the Tharsis operator's laugh better than her face.
阿瑞斯基地: 我对塔尔西斯那位操作员的笑声比她的脸还熟。

Ares Habitat: take the cadets on their first night drive
阿瑞斯基地: 带学员们第一次夜间驾驶

Ares Habitat: picnic at the crater rim with the cadets
阿瑞斯基地: 和学员们在陨石坑边野餐

Ares Habitat: watch the cadets' first solo walk
阿瑞斯基地: 看学员们第一次独自出舱

Ares Habitat: {name} ran drills with the cadets and {other}
Airlock drills with {other} and the cadets. Nine seconds!
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}带学员练气闸操作。九秒！

Ares Habitat: {other} timed the suit-up drill. Nobody's fast enough. Yet.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}给穿宇航服计时。还没人够快。暂时。

Ares Habitat: A cadet put their helmet on backwards. {other} didn't laugh. Much.
阿瑞斯基地: 一个学员把头盔戴反了。{other}没笑。没怎么笑。

Ares Habitat: Drilled the cadets with {other} till dinner. They'll be good.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}操练学员到晚饭。他们会很出色的。

Ares Habitat: {other} taught the cadets knots. I taught them patience.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}教学员打绳结。我教他们耐心。

Ares Habitat: Read the old manual cover to cover. Found a doodle on page ninety.
阿瑞斯基地: 把老手册从头读到尾。在第九十页发现了一幅涂鸦。

Ares Habitat: Studying at {place}. It's quiet till the cadets find me.
阿瑞斯基地: 在{place}学习。学员们找到我之前都很安静。

Ares Habitat: Relearned everything I forgot. There was a lot.
阿瑞斯基地: 把忘掉的东西重新学了一遍。忘了不少。

Ares Habitat: {friend} quizzed me on the manual. I passed. Barely.
阿瑞斯基地: {friend}考了我手册上的内容。我过了。勉强。

Ares Habitat: Fell asleep on the manual. Woke with a diagram on my cheek.
阿瑞斯基地: 在手册上睡着了。醒来脸上印着一张图表。

Ares Habitat: {name} ate supper with the cadets and {other}
The cadets asked {other} a hundred questions over supper.
阿瑞斯基地: 晚饭时学员们问了{other}一百个问题。

Ares Habitat: {other} told the cadets about the first landing. They were silent.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}给学员们讲了第一次着陆的事。他们鸦雀无声。

Ares Habitat: Supper with the cadets and {other}. So loud. So good.
阿瑞斯基地: 和学员们还有{other}吃晚饭。好吵。好开心。

Ares Habitat: A cadet cooked. {other} was brave. I was braver.
阿瑞斯基地: 一个学员下厨。{other}很勇敢。我更勇敢。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I got the cadets singing. Off key.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}带着学员们唱歌。都跑调了。

Ares Habitat: My cadet fixed a seal alone today. {other} saw. I'm proud.
阿瑞斯基地: 我带的学员今天独自修好了一个密封圈。{other}看见了。我很骄傲。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I wrote the cadets' reports. All good ones.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}写了学员们的报告。全是好评。

Ares Habitat: Taught a cadet to read the sky. {other} taught them to read me.
阿瑞斯基地: 我教一个学员看天。{other}教他们看我的脸色。

Ares Habitat: {other} says I'm a natural teacher. I'm a natural worrier.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}说我是天生的老师。我是天生的操心命。

Ares Habitat: A cadet thanked me. {other} pretended not to notice me tear up.
阿瑞斯基地: 一个学员谢了我。{other}假装没看见我眼眶湿了。

Ares Habitat: Posters on every wall. It looks like a student dorm. It is.
阿瑞斯基地: 每面墙上都贴着海报。看起来像学生宿舍。它就是。

Ares Habitat: The cadets grow radishes here. Mostly they grow mistakes.
阿瑞斯基地: 学员们在这里种萝卜。主要种出来的是错误。

Ares Habitat: Every dent on it is a lesson learned.
阿瑞斯基地: 车上的每个凹痕都是一堂学过的课。

Ares Habitat: They're so young. Were we that young?
阿瑞斯基地: 他们好年轻。我们以前也那么年轻吗？

Ares Habitat: One of them wants my job. Good. Let them.
阿瑞斯基地: 他们中有一个想要我的工作。好啊。让他们来。

Ares Habitat: I failed my first suit exam. Nobody knows that.
阿瑞斯基地: 我第一次宇航服考试没过。没人知道。

Ares Habitat: The exam's harder than Mars. Mars is fair.
阿瑞斯基地: 考试比火星还难。火星至少是公平的。

Ares Habitat: You learn a thing properly when you teach it.
阿瑞斯基地: 教别人的时候你才真正学会一样东西。

Ares Habitat: My old teacher would laugh to see me now.
阿瑞斯基地: 我的老师要是看到我现在的样子会笑出来的。
谁穿那件暖和的宇航服

Ares Habitat: explore the ice caves under the mine
take a bath with the new water, one each
阿瑞斯基地: 用新水洗个澡，一人一次

Ares Habitat: watch the ice glitter under the lamps
{name} worked a shift in the ice mine with {other}
{other} and I cut two tonnes of ice. My arms are jelly.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}凿了两吨冰。我的胳膊软得像果冻。

Ares Habitat: Mine shift with {other}. The ice glows blue down there.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}在矿里上班。那底下的冰泛着蓝光。

Ares Habitat: {other} found a bubble of old air in the ice. Very old air.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}在冰里发现了一个古老空气的气泡。非常古老的空气。

Ares Habitat: The drill jammed. {other} unjammed it with a song. Somehow.
阿瑞斯基地: 钻机卡住了。{other}唱了首歌就把它弄好了。不知怎么做到的。

Ares Habitat: Hauled ice with {other} till the carts were full.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}拖冰拖到矿车都装满了。

Ares Habitat: {name} had a hot bath from the new water
A real bath. First in three years. I cried a bit.
阿瑞斯基地: 真正的洗澡。三年来第一次。我有点想哭。

Ares Habitat: Five minutes of hot water. The best five minutes on Mars.
阿瑞斯基地: 五分钟的热水。火星上最美好的五分钟。

Ares Habitat: Bath night. {friend} got the water after me. Sorry.
阿瑞斯基地: 洗澡夜。{friend}用的是我洗过的水。抱歉。

Ares Habitat: Soaked till I wrinkled. Worth every drop.
阿瑞斯基地: 泡到皮肤都起皱了。每一滴都值。

Ares Habitat: Hot water, clean hair. I feel like a new person.
阿瑞斯基地: 热水，干净的头发。我感觉换了个人。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I found a cave shaped like a cathedral.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}发现了一个形状像大教堂的洞穴。

Ares Habitat: Our lamps made the whole cave sparkle. {other} went quiet.
阿瑞斯基地: 我们的灯让整个洞都闪闪发光。{other}安静下来了。

Ares Habitat: {other} shouted and the cave shouted back.
Crawled through a tunnel with {other}. Came out laughing.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}爬过一条隧道。出来时一直在笑。

Ares Habitat: {other} carved our initials in the ice. Very small.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}在冰上刻了我们名字的首字母。很小很小。

Ares Habitat: {name} planned the new water pipes with {other}
{other} and I drew the pipes on the wall. Then on paper.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}先在墙上画了管子。然后才画在纸上。

Ares Habitat: Water to every room by next window. {other} promised.
阿瑞斯基地: 下个窗口期前每个房间都通上水。{other}保证过的。

Ares Habitat: {other} worked out the pressure. I nodded wisely.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}算出了水压。我很有智慧地点点头。

Ares Habitat: Laid the first pipe with {other}. It leaked. Then it didn't.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}铺了第一根管子。漏了。后来不漏了。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I named the pipes after old rivers on Earth.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}用地球上古老河流的名字给管子命名。

Ares Habitat: Hot water, two taps, one queue. Always a queue.
阿瑞斯基地: 热水，两个水龙头，一条队。永远在排队。

Ares Habitat: Every drop in the greenhouse started as ice down the mine.
阿瑞斯基地: 温室里的每一滴水最初都是矿下的冰。

Ares Habitat: It's slow, it squeaks, and we'd be thirsty without it.
阿瑞斯基地: 它又慢又吱吱响，可没有它我们就得渴着。

Ares Habitat: It's cold, dark and the most important place on Ares.
阿瑞斯基地: 它又冷又黑，却是阿瑞斯最重要的地方。

Ares Habitat: There's ice down there older than the dinosaurs.
阿瑞斯基地: 那底下的冰比恐龙还古老。

Ares Habitat: On Earth I left the tap running. I think of that a lot.
阿瑞斯基地: 在地球上我会任由水龙头开着。我常常想起这件事。

Ares Habitat: Every glass of water here has a story.
阿瑞斯基地: 这里的每一杯水都有一个故事。

Ares Habitat: We found something in the ice. Might be nothing. Might be everything.
阿瑞斯基地: 我们在冰里发现了点东西。可能什么也不是。也可能意味着一切。

Ares Habitat: If there was ever life here, it's hiding very well.
阿瑞斯基地: 如果这里曾经有过生命，它藏得非常好。
谁吃了最后一个面包卷

Ares Habitat: watch the winter frost form on the dome
阿瑞斯基地: 看冬天的霜在穹顶上结起来

Ares Habitat: have a midwinter feast by lamplight
阿瑞斯基地: 在灯光下吃一顿冬至大餐

Ares Habitat: walk out to see the frozen CO2 on the rocks
阿瑞斯基地: 出去看岩石上冻结的二氧化碳

Ares Habitat: {name} kept the heaters running at {place} with {other}
{other} and I fixed the heater at two in the morning. Heroes.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}凌晨两点修好了取暖器。英雄。

Ares Habitat: Heater rounds with {other}. Every room, every hour.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}巡查取暖器。每个房间，每个小时。

Ares Habitat: {other} wrapped the pipes in old blankets. It worked.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}用旧毯子把管子裹了起来。管用了。

Ares Habitat: Frost on the inside of the window. {other} and I sealed it.
阿瑞斯基地: 窗户内侧结了霜。我和{other}把它封好了。

Ares Habitat: Fixed the heat exchanger with {other}. Warm again.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}修好了热交换器。又暖和了。

Ares Habitat: Three blankets and a book. Winter can do its worst.
阿瑞斯基地: 三条毯子和一本书。冬天随它怎么折腾吧。

Ares Habitat: Stayed in bed with cocoa. The dome's cold, I'm not.
阿瑞斯基地: 抱着可可待在床上。穹顶很冷，我不冷。

Ares Habitat: {friend} knitted me socks. They're lumpy. I love them.
阿瑞斯基地: {friend}给我织了袜子。疙疙瘩瘩的。我很喜欢。

Ares Habitat: Napped by the heater like a cat.
阿瑞斯基地: 像猫一样在取暖器边打盹。

Ares Habitat: Watched the frost grow on the window all afternoon.
阿瑞斯基地: 一下午都在看窗户上的霜慢慢长大。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I made stew from everything left. It was good!
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}用剩下的所有东西做了炖菜。很好吃！

Ares Habitat: Baked bread with {other}. The whole habitat came to smell it.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}烤面包。整个基地的人都来闻香味。

Ares Habitat: {other} invented a soup. We'll never make it again. Delicious.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}发明了一道汤。我们再也做不出来了。好喝。

Ares Habitat: Cooking with {other} keeps us warm. And fed.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}做饭让我们暖和。还能吃饱。

Ares Habitat: {other} burned the rolls. We ate them anyway. Crunchy.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}把面包卷烤焦了。我们还是吃了。脆脆的。

Ares Habitat: {name} checked on everyone through the long night with {other}
阿瑞斯基地: {name}和{other}在漫漫长夜里挨个探望大家

Ares Habitat: {other} and I knocked on every door. Everyone's warm.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}敲了每一扇门。大家都很暖和。

Ares Habitat: Brought tea round with {other}. Nobody said no.
{other} noticed someone was low. We sat with them.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}注意到有人情绪低落。我们陪着他们坐了会儿。

Ares Habitat: Night rounds with {other}. The habitat's asleep and safe.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}夜间巡查。基地已经睡了，很安全。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I left a note on every bunk. Just: hang on.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}在每张铺位上留了张纸条。只写着：坚持住。

Ares Habitat: the warmest corner of the mess
Right above the heat pipe. First come, first warm.
阿瑞斯基地: 就在暖气管正上方。先到先暖。

Ares Habitat: They keep the wheat thinking it's summer.
阿瑞斯基地: 它们让小麦以为现在还是夏天。

Ares Habitat: Best heater on Ares. Everyone sits in the rover to warm up.
阿瑞斯基地: 阿瑞斯最好的暖气。大家都坐进漫游车取暖。

Ares Habitat: A Martian winter lasts half a year. You learn to like soup.
阿瑞斯基地: 火星的冬天要持续半年。你会学着爱上汤。

Ares Habitat: The frost on the dome looks like ferns.
阿瑞斯基地: 穹顶上的霜看起来像蕨叶。

Ares Habitat: It's the not-knowing that's hard. When it'll end.
阿瑞斯基地: 难的是不知道。不知道什么时候结束。

Ares Habitat: We all got a bit closer this winter. Had to.
阿瑞斯基地: 这个冬天我们都靠得更近了。不得不这样。

Ares Habitat: There's nothing like bread when it's cold out.
阿瑞斯基地: 外面冷的时候，没什么比得上面包。

Ares Habitat: My grandmother's recipe works on Mars. She'd be amazed.
阿瑞斯基地: 我奶奶的方子在火星上也管用。她会惊呆的。

Ares Habitat: visit the moss test plot at dawn
阿瑞斯基地: 黎明时去看苔藓试验田

Ares Habitat: plant a tree together in the big dome
阿瑞斯基地: 一起在大穹顶里种一棵树
去新花园的小路上散步

Ares Habitat: {name} planted trees in the big dome with {other}
{other} and I planted six trees. Real trees, on Mars.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}种了六棵树。真正的树，在火星上。

Ares Habitat: Dug holes with {other} all morning. The trees went in by lunch.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}挖了一上午坑。午饭前树都种下了。

Ares Habitat: {other} named every tree. I'm not allowed to forget them.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}给每棵树都起了名字。我可不能忘了它们。

Ares Habitat: A tree's taller than me now. {other} measured.
阿瑞斯基地: 有棵树现在比我还高了。{other}量过的。

Ares Habitat: Watered the saplings with {other}. One has a leaf!
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}给树苗浇水。有一棵长出叶子了！

Ares Habitat: {name} sat with the moss plot at {place}
The moss is growing outside. Outside! In the open air!
阿瑞斯基地: 苔藓在外面长了。外面！露天的！

Ares Habitat: Sat by the moss plot. It's green against the red. Unbelievable.
阿瑞斯基地: 坐在苔藓田边。红色里的一点绿。难以置信。

Ares Habitat: Counted the moss patches. Nine. Yesterday it was eight.
阿瑞斯基地: 数了数苔藓斑块。九块。昨天还是八块。

Ares Habitat: {friend} says I watch the moss like it's television.
Just me and a bit of green. Mars is changing.
阿瑞斯基地: 只有我和一点绿色。火星正在改变。

Ares Habitat: {name} walked in the dome garden with {other}
{other} and I walked under actual leaves. We didn't talk. Didn't need to.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}在真正的树叶下散步。我们没说话。不需要。

Ares Habitat: The garden smells of Earth. {other} closed their eyes.
阿瑞斯基地: 花园里有地球的味道。{other}闭上了眼睛。

Ares Habitat: {other} found a ladybird. Someone brought ladybirds!
阿瑞斯基地: {other}发现了一只瓢虫。有人把瓢虫带来了！

Ares Habitat: Sat on the grass with {other}. Grass!
{other} picked me a flower. I pressed it in the log.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}给我摘了一朵花。我把它夹在日志里压干了。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I catalogued two hundred kinds of seed.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}给两百种种子编了目录。

Ares Habitat: Sent seeds to Tharsis with {other}. They'll grow there too.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}给塔尔西斯寄了种子。它们在那儿也会长的。

Ares Habitat: {other} found a seed packet from the first landing. Still good.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}找到了第一次着陆时的一包种子。还能用。

Ares Habitat: Labelled every drawer with {other}. In pencil, in case.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}给每个抽屉贴了标签。用铅笔写的，以防万一。

Ares Habitat: The seed library's the colony's future. {other} says so. So do I.
阿瑞斯基地: 种子库是殖民地的未来。{other}这么说。我也这么说。

Ares Habitat: Planted by everyone, one shovel each. It leans a bit.
阿瑞斯基地: 每个人都铲了一锹土种下的。它有点歪。

Ares Habitat: From here you can watch the moss grow outside. Slowly.
阿瑞斯基地: 从这里能看到外面的苔藓在长。很慢。

Ares Habitat: the seed drawers in the rover
We plant as we drive. Mars will be green by the tracks.
阿瑞斯基地: 我们边开车边播种。火星的车辙边会变绿的。

Ares Habitat: I'll be old when they're tall. That's all right.
阿瑞斯基地: 等它们长高时我已经老了。那也没关系。

Ares Habitat: Trees on Mars. My grandmother wouldn't believe it.
阿瑞斯基地: 火星上的树。我奶奶是不会相信的。

Ares Habitat: After years of red, green hurts your eyes. In a good way.
阿瑞斯基地: 看了这么多年红色，绿色会刺痛眼睛。是好的那种刺痛。

Ares Habitat: Somebody will be born here one day. Under those trees.

阿瑞斯基地: 在最高的冰檐上打了个盹。醒来胆子大了些。

Ares Habitat: Up here the wind's cold but the worry's gone.
阿瑞斯基地: 这上面风很冷，但担心没了。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I dove together. Eyes open, flippers ready.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}一起下潜。睁大眼睛，鳍都准备好了。

Ares Habitat: {other} watched my back. I watched their tail.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}看着我的背后。我看着他们的尾巴。

Ares Habitat: Buddy swim with {other}. We're getting good at this.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}结伴游泳。我们越来越默契了。

阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}约好了一个信号。拍两下鳍就是快游。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I taught the young ones to swim in pairs.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}教年轻的企鹅结伴游泳。

Ares Habitat: Swim lesson with {other}. Every chick knows the alarm now.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}上游泳课。每只小企鹅现在都知道警报声了。

Ares Habitat: {other} played the seal. The chicks swam away beautifully.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}扮演海豹。小企鹅们游开的样子漂亮极了。

Ares Habitat: Taught escape turns with {other}. Quick left, quick right.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}教逃生转身。快速左转，快速右转。

Ares Habitat: {other} says the young ones are faster than us now. True.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}说年轻的现在比我们快了。确实。

阿瑞斯基地: 一吹响，所有人都会瞬间离开水面。

Ares Habitat: The seal can't reach this one. We checked. Carefully.
阿瑞斯基地: 海豹够不着这个洞。我们检查过了。很仔细。

Ares Habitat: Every sighting, scratched on the council stone.
阿瑞斯基地: 每一次目击，都刻在议会的石头上。

Ares Habitat: It has a smile like a crack in the ice. Not a nice smile.
阿瑞斯基地: 它的笑像冰上的裂缝。不是好看的笑。

Ares Habitat: It's just hungry. Everyone's just hungry.
阿瑞斯基地: 它只是饿了。大家都只是饿了。

Ares Habitat: Brave isn't not being scared. It's diving anyway.
阿瑞斯基地: 勇敢不是不害怕。是害怕了还照样下潜。

Ares Habitat: The bravest penguin I know is also the most careful.
阿瑞斯基地: 我认识的最勇敢的企鹅，也是最谨慎的。

Ares Habitat: In the water I'm fast and graceful. On land, less so.
阿瑞斯基地: 在水里我又快又优雅。在陆地上就没那么好了。

Ares Habitat: I learned to swim by falling in. Most of us did.
阿瑞斯基地: 我是掉进水里学会游泳的。我们大多数都是。

drift on a loose floe for an afternoon

阿瑞斯基地: {other}掉进了一块薄冰里。只到膝盖。事后我们都笑了。

阿瑞斯基地: 在浮冰上漂了一下午。它把我送回来了。大致上。

Ares Habitat: The early thaw means warm sun. I'm not complaining.
阿瑞斯基地: 提前解冻意味着暖和的太阳。我可不抱怨。

Ares Habitat: {friend} waved from the shore. I waved from the floe.

Ares Habitat: Lay on the slushy ice and let the sun do its work.
阿瑞斯基地: 躺在湿漉漉的冰上，让太阳慢慢晒。

Ares Habitat: Drifting's the best kind of lazy.

阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}把四十块鹅卵石搬到新筑窝的地方。

Ares Habitat: Moving day with {other}. Every pebble counted, every egg safe.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}搬家的一天。每块鹅卵石都数过了，每个蛋都安全。

阿瑞斯基地: 新窝都在结实的冰上。{other}跺了一脚检查过。

Ares Habitat: Helped {other} build a nest. It's the best one. Don't tell the others.
阿瑞斯基地: 帮{other}筑了个窝。是最好的一个。别告诉别人。

阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}往裂缝里塞雪。桥撑住了。

Ares Habitat: Mended two spans with {other}. The bridge creaks less.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}修好了两段桥。桥的吱嘎声小了。

Ares Habitat: {other} found driftwood for the worst span. Clever.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}给最糟的那段找来了浮木。聪明。

Ares Habitat: The bridge is patched with {other}'s wood and my stubbornness.
阿瑞斯基地: 这座桥是用{other}的木头和我的倔强补好的。

Ares Habitat: {other} and I crossed the mended bridge first. Carefully.
阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}第一个走过修好的桥。小心翼翼地。

阿瑞斯基地: 它是解冻时裂开的。我们像鹰一样盯着它。企鹅鹰。

Ares Habitat: The thaw made a pool. The chicks think it's for them.
阿瑞斯基地: 解冻形成了一个水池。小企鹅们以为那是给他们的。

Ares Habitat: Every thaw we redraw it. It gets smaller.
阿瑞斯基地: 每次解冻我们都要重画。它越来越小。

Ares Habitat: The ice sings when it cracks. A sad song.
阿瑞斯基地: 冰裂开时会唱歌。一首悲伤的歌。

Ares Habitat: Every thaw the floe's a little smaller. We manage.
阿瑞斯基地: 每次解冻浮冰都会小一点。我们会应付的。

Ares Habitat: A good nest takes forty pebbles and a lot of love.
阿瑞斯基地: 一个好窝需要四十块鹅卵石和很多很多爱。

Ares Habitat: I've built eleven nests. This one's the best.
阿瑞斯基地: 我筑过十一个窝。这个是最好的。

Ares Habitat: The ice changes. So do we. That's being a colony.
阿瑞斯基地: 冰在变。我们也在变。这就是聚居地。

Ares Habitat: My grandmother's floe is sea now. She'd shrug.
阿瑞斯基地: 我奶奶的那块浮冰现在已经是大海了。她会耸耸肩。

阿瑞斯基地: {other}在新浮冰上挖了第一个庇护所。很舒服。

Ares Habitat: Worked the new floe with {other} till the tide turned.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}在新浮冰上干活，一直干到潮水转向。

阿瑞斯基地: 在两块浮冰之间漂着。两边都是家。

阿瑞斯基地: 水道很平静。我仰面躺着看天。

Ares Habitat: {friend} swam past and splashed me. Then floated too.
阿瑞斯基地: {friend}游过来溅了我一身水。然后也漂了起来。

Ares Habitat: Halfway between old and new. A good place to think.
阿瑞斯基地: 在旧与新之间的半路上。一个适合思考的地方。

Ares Habitat: The water's warmer between the floes. Nobody knows why.
阿瑞斯基地: 两块浮冰之间的水更暖。没人知道为什么。

Ares Habitat: {name} visited friends on the new floe with {other}

阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}游过去在新浮冰上吃晚饭。

Ares Habitat: Visited the new floe with {other}. They've got a better slide.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}去了新浮冰。他们的滑道更好。

阿瑞斯基地: {other}想念旧浮冰。我带他们看了新的日落。

阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}在水对岸吃晚饭。我们吃饱了游回家。

阿瑞斯基地: 我和{other}从新浮冰比赛游回来。平局。

阿瑞斯基地: {other}提议在两块浮冰之间建座桥。大家都欢呼了。

Ares Habitat: {other} gave a speech about home. Both floes went quiet.

阿瑞斯基地: 从这里能同时看到两个家。

阿瑞斯基地: 冰山来回漂着。我们免费搭乘。

阿瑞斯基地: 两块浮冰上各有一半的石头。我们隔水喊话。

阿瑞斯基地: 它比我们的平。更适合滑行。

阿瑞斯基地: 我家一半的人现在住在那儿。我每天都去看看。

Ares Habitat: You can miss a place that's right across the water.
阿瑞斯基地: 你可以想念一个就在水对面的地方。
鹅卵石在哪里，家就在哪里。

Ares Habitat: The channel's where the two floes shake hands.
阿瑞斯基地: 水道是两块浮冰握手的地方。

阿瑞斯基地: 我每天游两趟。我的鳍现在很有力了。

sing at the song circle together
make up a song on the berg

阿瑞斯基地: {other}说我们准备好了。合唱团可不这么认为。

Ares Habitat: Song circle with {other}. Everyone took a verse.

Ares Habitat: {other} and I sang a duet. The gulls left.

Ares Habitat: The song went round the circle and came back new.

Ares Habitat: {other} can hold a note longer than anyone. Showed off all night.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}能比谁都拉更长的音。显摆了一整晚。

Ares Habitat: {other} found the rhyme for 'herring'. I'm still amazed.
阿瑞斯基地: {other}给“鲱鱼”找到了押韵的词。我到现在还很惊讶。

Ares Habitat: New song with {other}. It's about all of us.
阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}写了首新歌。是关于我们所有人的。

阿瑞斯基地: {other}想要悲伤的歌。我想要好笑的。结果两样都有。

阿瑞斯基地: 和{other}把新歌教给小企鹅们。他们到处都在唱。

阿瑞斯基地: 在这里唱歌，桥会唱回来。

阿瑞斯基地: 刻在冰上。聚居地编过的每一首歌。

阿瑞斯基地: 我们唱得不好。但我们很响亮。这也算数。

Ares Habitat: I sing the low part. Somebody has to.
阿瑞斯基地: 我唱低音部分。总得有人唱。

Ares Habitat: The old songs are about the ice. The new ones are about us.
阿瑞斯基地: 老歌唱的是冰。新歌唱的是我们。
